title: Billing Standard for Commercial Natural Gas Supply Bill Lines
content:
## 1. Lines per cycle

Each billing cycle in which Beacon Ridge supplied the site produces one energy charge line, any swing lines, one monthly service fee line unless waived, and one sales tax line when tax applies. Commercial Natural Gas Supply charges are billed only while the agreement is active, drop pending or closed, as its status on the agreement record shows.

## 2. Energy price per therm

| Plan structure | Energy price per therm |
|---|---|
| Fixed | The agreement's contract rate |
| Fixed basis | The month's NYMEX settlement price plus the contract rate, as a sum |
| Index | The month's delivered index price plus the contract rate, as a sum |

The month's prices are taken from the monthly index price notice for the month of the cycle's billing period start. Each amount is the usage multiplied by the price, rounded half up to the cent.

## 3. Service fee and the dual-commodity waiver

Holding an active Beacon Ridge business electricity agreement (Small Business Electricity Supply) or commercial and industrial contract (Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts) on the same site changes the gas fee: when the plan provides the dual-commodity fee waiver and such an agreement was active on the cycle's billing period start, no monthly service fee line is billed for that cycle.

## 4. Sales tax

The sales tax line taxes the cycle's energy, swing and fee lines at the sales tax rate for the site's service state. Its amount is the taxable amount multiplied by the tax rate and divided by 100, rounded to the cent. No sales tax line is billed when that state's rate is 0.000 percent, or for cycles beginning on or after the tax exemption date when the site is sales tax exempt. Tax billed before an exemption is not refunded.

## 5. True-up

There is no annual volume true-up when the plan does not bill one.

## Worked cycle (hypothetical inputs)

A Pennsylvania site on a Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas fixed plan with a hypothetical contract rate of $0.6500 per therm uses 1,000 therms inside its band in a cycle; the plan's fee is $14.95 and no waiver applies.

- Energy charge: 1,000 therms multiplied by $0.6500 is $650.00.
- Monthly service fee: $14.95.
- Sales tax: the taxable amount is $650.00 plus $14.95, that is $664.95; multiplied by 6.000 and divided by 100 it is $39.897, billed as $39.90.

The same cycle at an Ohio site carries no sales tax line, because the Ohio rate is 0.000 percent.

## Waiver judgement

| Plan provides the waiver | Business electricity agreement or C&I contract on the same site active on the billing period start | Fee line for the cycle |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Not billed |
| Yes | No | Billed |
| No | Either | Billed |
